top_sast_rules.description: A restricted route, URL, script, or file can be requested directly without required authorization.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-425 forced-browsing direct-request restricted-url protected-route protected-file missing-authorization route endpoint hidden-link
top_sast_rules.remediation: Authorize every protected route and resource on direct access.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Link Resolution Before File Access ('Link Following')
top_sast_rules.description: File access follows a symlink, hardlink, or shortcut to an unintended resource.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-59 symlink hardlink link-following symbolic-link file-link archive-extraction path-resolution file-overwrite race filesystem
top_sast_rules.remediation: Reject unsafe links and verify resolved file targets before access.

top_sast_rules.description: Legacy category for insecure credential creation, storage, validation, or handling.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-255 credential-management password token secret credential storage rotation validation authentication-secret
top_sast_rules.remediation: Protect credentials throughout storage, validation, transport, and rotation.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')
top_sast_rules.description: Externally influenced data changes the syntax or meaning of a command sent to a downstream command interpreter.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-77 command-injection command-construction shell exec spawn process subprocess child_process os.system popen argument-delimiter metacharacter
top_sast_rules.remediation: Keep external data separate from command syntax and use safe argument APIs.

top_sast_rules.description: A read accesses memory before or beyond the valid buffer range.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-125 out-of-bounds-read buffer-read memory-read index offset length parser decode malformed-input boundary
top_sast_rules.remediation: Check read offsets, indexes, and lengths before buffer access.

top_sast_rules.description: Sensitive data is stored or transmitted without required encryption.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-311 missing-encryption cleartext plaintext sensitive-data unencrypted storage transmission tls data-at-rest data-in-transit
top_sast_rules.remediation: Encrypt sensitive data in transit and at rest.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere
top_sast_rules.description: A protected resource crosses its intended trust or control boundary and becomes accessible to an unintended actor.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-668 wrong-sphere control-sphere trust-boundary resource-exposure unintended-actor private-resource public-exposure insecure-permission cross-boundary
top_sast_rules.remediation: Keep protected resources inside their intended trust boundary.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Information Exposure Through Debug Log Files
top_sast_rules.description: Sensitive information is written to debug or diagnostic log files.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-534 debug-log diagnostic-log verbose-log sensitive-log password token credential secret exception stacktrace logging
top_sast_rules.remediation: Redact secrets and disable sensitive diagnostic logging.

top_sast_rules.description: Legacy category for cryptographic design or implementation weaknesses.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-310 cryptography cipher encryption decryption tls ssl certificate hash randomness key cryptographic-protocol
top_sast_rules.remediation: Use approved cryptographic algorithms, protocols, keys, and certificate validation.

top_sast_rules.description: An authorization check exists but evaluates access incorrectly.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-863 incorrect-authorization authorization-check permission-check role-check ownership-check acl-check access-decision bypass
top_sast_rules.remediation: Evaluate authorization from trusted server-side identity and policy state.
